top_signals.title: Schwab CEO Says It's Easy to Find Top Talent in Texas
top_signals.summary: Schwab Corp. Chief Executive Officer Rick Wurster says Texas' cost of living, strong universities and tax advantages versus other states have helped the Westlake-based company recruit employees since relocating from San Francisco in 2021. Schwab now has almost 11,000 Texas employees, he tells Bloomberg's Julie Fine. (Source: Bloomberg)
